title: tc-tree-select
description: Pick one or many options from a nested hierarchy, with type-to-filter and parent checkboxes.

value.description: The picked id (or ids, with `multiple`); null for nothing. Changed by the user unless a tc-value-change listener calls preventDefault()

multiple.description: Pick many: every row gets a checkbox

cascade.description: With `multiple`, checking a parent checks everything enabled beneath it; set cascade="false" to check rows on their own

open.description: Whether the tree is open. Changed by the user unless a tc-open-change listener calls preventDefault()

label.description: Visible label above the field (or use a page <label for>)

emptyText.description: Shown when nothing matches the filter

maxChips.description: With `multiple`, show at most this many chips in the field, the rest as "+N more"

name.description: Submitted with the form: the id, or one entry per id with `multiple`

disabled.description: Can't be changed or focused; also disabled inside a disabled <fieldset>

required.description: Something must be picked before the form submits
